templates.title: certguard
templates.name: certguard
templates.description: Active TLS certificate, API-key & subscription expiry monitor with an encrypted (optionally zero-knowledge) secret vault, alerts, and a calendar view.
templates.note: Serves on the chosen port (default 8181). On first visit it prompts you to create an admin — or fill the Admin email/password fields to have it created automatically. For HTTPS, put certguard behind your existing reverse proxy and set 'Behind HTTPS proxy' to Yes, or use docker-compose.aio.yml from the repo for a self-contained certificate. Never delete the volume unless you mean to erase everything.

env.name: CERTGUARD_PORT
env.label: Web port
env.description: Host port to publish the UI on.

env.name: CERTGUARD_ADMIN_EMAIL
env.label: Admin email (optional)
env.description: Fill both admin fields to auto-create the first admin. Leave blank to create it in the browser on first visit.

env.name: CERTGUARD_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Admin password (optional, 8+ chars)
env.description: Only used once, on an empty database. Remove it after your first login.

env.name: CERTGUARD_COOKIE_SECURE
env.label: Behind an HTTPS proxy?
env.description: Set to Yes if a reverse proxy terminates HTTPS in front of certguard.

env.name: CERTGUARD_CHECK_INTERVAL
env.label: Rescan interval
env.description: How often to re-scan endpoints and evaluate alerts (e.g. 6h, 12h, 24h).
